title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The engines' own state is read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. An ATOM entry at 2.066 came after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Open positions and the market filter
- htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper.
- htf-rsi-v007 closed trades so far: 4, average null net per trade.
- trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter on.
- trend-daily-v005 has 1 position open on paper: UNIUSDT since 2026-11-05T00:00:00.000Z.
- trend-daily-v005 closed trades so far: 5, average -13.68% net per trade.
- trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter on.
- trend-daily-v006 has 2 positions open on paper: UNIUSDT since 2026-11-05T00:00:00.000Z and HYPEUSDT since 2026-10-30T00:00:00.000Z.
- trend-daily-v006 closed trades so far: 5, average -13.68% net per trade.
- This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-05T20:32:01.756Z.

The filter being on is the engines' own reported state. It is not a forecast, and it does not imply that any new entry will follow. The open paper positions are simply what remains open under each engine's rules at the snapshot time. htf-rsi-v007 shows 0 open positions and 4 closed trades with average null net per trade, so its record contains no open exposure at the snapshot time.

## Most recent closed trades
- ATOM entered at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close.
- ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703.
- That ATOM result is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip.
- NEAR entered at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 and has been open since.
- htf-rsi-v007 closed trades so far: 4, average null net per trade.
- trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006 each show closed trades so far: 5, average -13.68% net per trade.

The ATOM exit happened because the price closed below the 10-day low, which is the stated exit rule for that trade. The measurement attached to that rule is an exit at 1.703 and a result of −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. For the trend-daily engines, the completed trades so far average -13.68% net per trade; that is the measured outcome of the closed portion of the record, not a projection for open positions. NEAR remains open, so it has no completed result in this record.

## Distance to the 20-day breakout
- trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006 report the same nearest symbols.
- UNIUSDT is -2.31% below its high.
- ZECUSDT is 1.44% below its high.
- ETHUSDT is 1.99% below its high.

These figures measure how far each symbol is from its 20-day high. They are status readings from the live record. They do not say whether a breakout will occur, and they are not instructions to trade. The same symbols are reported for both trend-daily engines.

## What the record does and does not show
- Every position in this record is paper; no real orders are placed.
- 1 trade says nothing about a strategy.
- htf-rsi-v007 shows 4 closed trades with average null net per trade.
- trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006 show 5 closed trades each with average -13.68% net per trade.
- The record updates continuously.
- The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

The live snapshot was read at 2026-11-05T20:32:01.756Z. Because the record updates continuously, the counts, open positions, and distances above can change after that time. The page is reporting state, not offering a conclusion about future performance. The framing remains paper signals only, and 1 trade says nothing about a strategy.
